name: o65453

schema.description: An identifier for an entity (possibly other things, e.g. securities in the future). Examples are tax IDs, non-profit IDs, SEC CIK numbers, Federal Reserve RSSD id. The main requirements for an identifier is that they should be well-defined, and issued by a government or have statutory standing

uid.description: The unique identifier given by the identifier system – it should be unique in the context of the identifier_system

identifier_system_code.description: An identifier representing the identifier scheme. Some examples of this are us_fein (US Federal tax number), us_sec_cik (US Securities and Exchange Commission CIK), uk_ew_cc (Charity Commission of England & Wales), lei (Global Legal Entity Identifier System)

description: The organization’s Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) is 12-3456789, assigned under the U.S. FEIN identifier system (code us_fein). This identifier uniquely distinguishes the entity within the federal tax database.
